name: NY Pizzeria
notes: All 5 photos are digital menu boards for the same pizzeria (baseball-player-themed pizza names). Several boards show the same pizza names at different prices (NY Pie vs SD Square Pan vs Detroit-style vs daily specials); kept one representative price per distinct board/section rather than merging conflicting prices. Dropped daily promo lines (e.g. 'Monday NY Pies $14/$18') as discounts on already-listed items, and dropped combo Family Packs as bundles rather than dishes.
